title: THE 90 DAY
PLAN
scenes.sub: Full GATE ME syllabus, step by step
scenes.voice: Ninety days, the complete GATE Mechanical syllabus, and a clear plan for every single day. Here is how it is split.

scenes.title: The Plan
scenes.voice: Sixty-six days to cover the full syllabus, twelve days of subject revision, then twelve days of mocks and formula sprints, with eight full-length mocks in GATE pattern.

scenes.title: Planned By
scenes.voice: The plan is designed by a GATE all India rank sixteen and E. S. E. all India rank sixty-one.

scenes.title: Mark Your Calendar
scenes.voice: It ends a week before GATE, so you walk in fully revised. Day one is Monday, nineteenth October.
